hypothesis: The learning rate that improved macro-F1 in all three training-only folds will improve original validation macro-F1 without a large increase in fault-to-normal errors.
test_policy: Use original train for updates and original val for checkpoint selection; never load original test. No external sUAS data in training or selection.
budget_note: Existing full-train layer-4 run took 309 seconds for four epochs on this CPU; CV fine-tuning epochs took about 55-65 seconds on 9,297 training images. Allow at most six original-train epochs and 720 seconds. Recheck with this script smoke run before full training.
stopping_rule: Stop at six epochs, after two non-improving original-validation macro-F1 epochs, or at 720 seconds, whichever comes first.
